name: SSC Common Error Spotting Mixed Practice
description: Exam-style A/B/C/D error spotting practice with corrections, rules, and memory hooks.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The quality of these mangoes / (B) are very good / (C) this season. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is very good

Rule: The real subject is quality, which is singular.

Memory hook: Do not trust the nearest noun.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The list of selected candidates / (B) have been uploaded / (C) on the official website. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: has been uploaded

Rule: List is singular.

Memory hook: A list may contain many names, but it is one list.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Each of the players / (B) were given / (C) a certificate. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: was given

Rule: Each is singular.

Memory hook: Each means one by one.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Neither of the answers / (B) are correct / (C) in this question. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is correct

Rule: Neither is singular in this structure.

Memory hook: Neither means not one.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Either of these roads / (B) lead to the station / (C) before sunset. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: leads to the station

Rule: Either is singular.

Memory hook: Either behaves like one option.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) A number of students / (B) has applied / (C) for the scholarship. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: have applied

Rule: A number of means many.

Memory hook: Many students need have.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The number of applicants / (B) are increasing / (C) every year. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is increasing

Rule: The number refers to one figure.

Memory hook: One number, one verb.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Many a student / (B) have lost marks / (C) in this section. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: has lost marks

Rule: Many a takes singular noun and singular verb.

Memory hook: Many a looks plural but acts singular.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) More than one candidate / (B) have complained / (C) about the delay. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: has complained

Rule: More than one usually takes singular verb in exam grammar.

Memory hook: The phrase means many, but behaves singular.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The news / (B) are shocking / (C) to everyone. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is shocking

Rule: News is singular despite ending in s.

Memory hook: News wears an s but acts singular.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Mathematics / (B) are my favourite subject / (C) in school. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is my favourite subject

Rule: Subject names ending in s are singular.

Memory hook: Mathematics is one field.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The scissors / (B) is lying / (C) on the table. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: are lying

Rule: Scissors is treated as plural.

Memory hook: Two blades, plural behaviour.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) A pair of scissors / (B) are missing / (C) from the drawer. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is missing

Rule: A pair is singular.

Memory hook: The pair is one unit.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The police / (B) is investigating / (C) the matter carefully. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: are investigating

Rule: Police is treated as plural.

Memory hook: Police means people in uniform.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The cattle / (B) is grazing / (C) near the pond. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: are grazing

Rule: Cattle is plural.

Memory hook: Cattle are not one cow.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Bread and butter / (B) are my usual breakfast / (C) before school. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is my usual breakfast

Rule: A combined food idea takes singular verb.

Memory hook: One breakfast plate, one verb.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The poet and philosopher / (B) are remembered / (C) for his ideas. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is remembered

Rule: One person with two roles takes singular verb when only first noun has article.

Memory hook: One person, two labels.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The poet and the philosopher / (B) is remembered / (C) for their ideas. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: are remembered

Rule: Two articles usually mean two people.

Memory hook: Two the's, two persons.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Neither the teacher nor the students / (B) is ready / (C) for the inspection. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: are ready

Rule: Verb agrees with nearer subject students.

Memory hook: The verb obeys the nearest subject.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Neither the students nor the teacher / (B) are ready / (C) for the inspection. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is ready

Rule: Verb agrees with nearer subject teacher.

Memory hook: Nearest subject decides.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The captain along with his players / (B) are present / (C) on the field. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is present

Rule: Along with does not change the main subject.

Memory hook: Ignore the guest phrase.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) There is / (B) many reasons / (C) for his failure. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: There are

Rule: The verb after there agrees with the real subject reasons.

Memory hook: Look after there for the subject.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) One-third of the students / (B) is absent / (C) today. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: are absent

Rule: Fraction of a plural noun takes plural verb.

Memory hook: One-third of students are still students.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) One-third of the work / (B) are complete / (C) already. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is complete

Rule: Work is uncountable and singular.

Memory hook: Work behaves as one mass.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The criteria / (B) is too strict / (C) for most candidates. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: are too strict

Rule: Criteria is plural. Criterion is singular.

Memory hook: Criteria are many filters.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The furniture / (B) are expensive / (C) in this shop. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: is expensive

Rule: Furniture is uncountable.

Memory hook: Furniture never becomes furnitures.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He has / (B) went to the market / (C) with his brother. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: gone to the market

Rule: Has is followed by V3.

Memory hook: Has gone, not has went.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She had / (B) saw the movie / (C) before the exam. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: seen the movie

Rule: Had is followed by V3.

Memory hook: Had seen is the correct pair.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) They have / (B) ate their lunch / (C) already. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: eaten their lunch

Rule: Have takes past participle.

Memory hook: Have eaten, not have ate.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He did not / (B) went there / (C) yesterday. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: go there

Rule: Did not takes base verb.

Memory hook: Did already carries past tense.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Did you / (B) saw him / (C) near the station? / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: see him

Rule: Did takes base verb.

Memory hook: After did, verb becomes simple.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She does not / (B) likes coffee / (C) at all. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: like coffee

Rule: Does not takes base verb.

Memory hook: Does carries the s.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He / (B) go to school / (C) by bus daily. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: goes to school

Rule: Singular third person takes s/es in simple present.

Memory hook: He goes, they go.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The boys / (B) goes to school / (C) by bus daily. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: go to school

Rule: Plural subject takes base verb.

Memory hook: Boys do not need goes.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I am / (B) knowing the answer / (C) to this question. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: know the answer

Rule: Know is stative and not normally continuous.

Memory hook: You know, not are knowing.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She is / (B) having a car / (C) of her own. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: has a car

Rule: Have meaning possession is not normally continuous.

Memory hook: Possession uses has.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I am living here / (B) since 2020 / (C) with my family. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: I have been living here

Rule: Use present perfect continuous with since for continuing action.

Memory hook: Since builds bridge from past to now.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She is waiting / (B) for two hours / (C) outside the office. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: She has been waiting

Rule: For plus duration continuing to present takes present perfect continuous.

Memory hook: Still waiting means has been waiting.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I know him / (B) since childhood / (C) very well. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: I have known him

Rule: Continuing state with since takes present perfect.

Memory hook: Known connects past to present.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He has visited Delhi / (B) yesterday / (C) with his friends. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: He visited Delhi

Rule: Use simple past with yesterday.

Memory hook: Yesterday rejects present perfect.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She has called me / (B) last night / (C) after dinner. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: She called me

Rule: Finished past time takes simple past.

Memory hook: Last night locks the sentence in past.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I have met him / (B) two days ago / (C) at the library. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: I met him

Rule: Ago takes simple past.

Memory hook: Ago is a past-time stamp.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) When I reached / (B) he left / (C) the office. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: he had left

Rule: Earlier of two past actions takes past perfect.

Memory hook: He left before I reached.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The train left / (B) before we reached / (C) the platform. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: The train had left

Rule: Earlier past action takes had plus V3.

Memory hook: Train escaped first.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I will call you / (B) when I will reach / (C) home. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: when I reach

Rule: Future time clauses use present tense.

Memory hook: When clause does not need will.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) If he will work hard / (B) he will pass / (C) the examination. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: If he works hard

Rule: First conditional uses if plus simple present.

Memory hook: If clause hates extra will.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Unless you will hurry / (B) you will miss / (C) the train. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: Unless you hurry

Rule: Use present tense after unless for future meaning.

Memory hook: Unless already sets condition.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I wish / (B) I am rich / (C) enough to help everyone. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: I were rich

Rule: Wish for unreal present uses were.

Memory hook: Wish creates unreal grammar.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) If I was you / (B) I would apologise / (C) immediately. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: If I were you

Rule: Unreal condition uses were in standard exam grammar.

Memory hook: If I were you is fixed.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) If I would have known / (B) I would have helped / (C) you earlier. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: If I had known

Rule: Third conditional uses if plus had V3.

Memory hook: Would stays out of the if-clause.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) It is time / (B) you go home / (C) now. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: you went home

Rule: It is time is followed by past tense.

Memory hook: Time pushes verb into past form.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He talks / (B) as if he knows everything / (C) about the subject. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: as if he knew everything

Rule: Unreal comparison after as if takes past tense.

Memory hook: He does not know everything.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He made me / (B) to wait / (C) for an hour. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: wait

Rule: Make plus object takes bare infinitive.

Memory hook: Make someone wait, not to wait.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Let him / (B) to go / (C) outside. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: go

Rule: Let plus object takes base verb.

Memory hook: Let removes to.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I heard him / (B) to sing / (C) in the hall. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: sing

Rule: Verbs of perception take bare infinitive for complete action.

Memory hook: Hear someone sing.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Avoid / (B) to make mistakes / (C) in the exam. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: making mistakes

Rule: Avoid is followed by gerund.

Memory hook: Avoid doing.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He denied / (B) to steal the money / (C) from the drawer. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: stealing the money

Rule: Deny is followed by gerund.

Memory hook: Deny doing.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I look forward / (B) to meet you / (C) soon. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: to meeting you

Rule: Look forward to takes gerund because to is a preposition.

Memory hook: This to behaves like a preposition.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He insisted / (B) to go there / (C) alone. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: on going there

Rule: Insist takes on plus gerund.

Memory hook: Insist on doing.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She succeeded / (B) to pass the exam / (C) this year. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: in passing the exam

Rule: Succeed takes in plus gerund.

Memory hook: Success comes with in.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is used / (B) to work hard / (C) in difficult conditions. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: to working hard

Rule: Be used to takes gerund.

Memory hook: Accustomed to doing.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I used to / (B) going there / (C) every Sunday. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: go there

Rule: Used to for past habit takes base verb.

Memory hook: Used to do.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He must / (B) goes now / (C) before it gets dark. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: go now

Rule: Modals take base verb.

Memory hook: Must go, not must goes.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She can / (B) sings well / (C) in public. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: sing well

Rule: Can takes base verb.

Memory hook: Can sing is enough.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is / (B) a honest man / (C) in every situation. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: an honest man

Rule: Use an before vowel sound. Honest has silent h.

Memory hook: Sound decides article.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She reached / (B) after a hour / (C) of waiting. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: after an hour

Rule: Hour begins with vowel sound.

Memory hook: Silent h invites an.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is / (B) an university student / (C) from Bhopal. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: a university student

Rule: University begins with consonant sound yu.

Memory hook: You sound takes a.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is / (B) an European scholar / (C) of history. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: a European scholar

Rule: European begins with consonant sound yu.

Memory hook: European sounds like you-ropean.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He bought / (B) an one-rupee coin / (C) from the fair. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: a one-rupee coin

Rule: One begins with w sound.

Memory hook: One sounds like won.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She is / (B) a IAS officer / (C) posted in Delhi. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: an IAS officer

Rule: IAS begins with vowel sound eye.

Memory hook: Pronunciation decides article.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He filed / (B) a FIR / (C) yesterday. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: an FIR

Rule: FIR begins with vowel sound ef.

Memory hook: Ef needs an.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He bought / (B) an useful tool / (C) for the workshop. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: a useful tool

Rule: Useful begins with consonant sound yu.

Memory hook: Useful sounds like you-seful.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The honesty / (B) is the best policy / (C) in life. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: Honesty

Rule: Abstract nouns used generally take no article.

Memory hook: General values need no the.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The gold / (B) is precious / (C) in every country. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: Gold

Rule: Material nouns used generally take no article.

Memory hook: Gold in general stands alone.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The water / (B) is necessary / (C) for life. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: Water

Rule: Uncountable nouns used generally take no article.

Memory hook: Water as a general idea needs no the.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He plays / (B) guitar well / (C) in college functions. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: the guitar well

Rule: Use the before musical instruments after play.

Memory hook: Play the guitar, play cricket.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She plays / (B) the cricket / (C) every Sunday. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: cricket

Rule: Games usually take no article.

Memory hook: Sports hate the.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) His father went / (B) to school / (C) to meet the principal. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: to the school

Rule: A parent visits a specific school building.

Memory hook: Students go to school, parents go to the school.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He went / (B) to the school / (C) by bus daily. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: to school

Rule: Use no article for school as normal purpose.

Memory hook: Students go to school.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The Delhi / (B) is the capital / (C) of India. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: Delhi

Rule: City names usually take no article.

Memory hook: Cities stand alone.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The India / (B) is a diverse country / (C) with many languages. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: India

Rule: Most country names take no article.

Memory hook: India needs no the.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Ganga / (B) is a holy river / (C) in India. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: The Ganga

Rule: Use the before river names.

Memory hook: Rivers flow with the.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) Himalayas / (B) are snow-covered / (C) for much of the year. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: The Himalayas

Rule: Use the before mountain ranges.

Memory hook: Ranges take the.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The Mount Everest / (B) is the highest peak / (C) in the world. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: Mount Everest

Rule: Individual mountain peaks usually take no article.

Memory hook: Peak names stand alone.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is / (B) best player / (C) in the team. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: the best player

Rule: Use the with superlatives.

Memory hook: Best needs the.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) This is / (B) same book / (C) I wanted. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: the same book

Rule: Use the before same.

Memory hook: Same always wants the.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) More you practise / (B) better you become / (C) in grammar. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part A

Correction: The more you practise

Rule: Use the...the in parallel comparatives.

Memory hook: Two comparatives need two the's.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is / (B) senior than me / (C) in the office. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: senior to me

Rule: Senior takes to, not than.

Memory hook: Senior belongs to the to-family.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She is / (B) junior than her sister / (C) in school. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: junior to her sister

Rule: Junior takes to.

Memory hook: Junior to, senior to.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) This book is / (B) superior than that one / (C) in quality. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: superior to that one

Rule: Superior takes to.

Memory hook: Superior behaves like senior.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is / (B) married with a doctor / (C) from Jaipur. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: married to a doctor

Rule: Married takes to.

Memory hook: Married to is fixed.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She is / (B) good in mathematics / (C) and science. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: good at mathematics

Rule: Good at is used for skills and subjects.

Memory hook: Ability sits at.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is / (B) weak at grammar / (C) but strong in maths. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: weak in grammar

Rule: Weak in is used for subjects or areas.

Memory hook: Weak in a subject.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is suffering / (B) with fever / (C) since Monday. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: from fever

Rule: Suffer from disease.

Memory hook: Disease comes from.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She is / (B) angry on me / (C) for being late. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: angry with me

Rule: Angry with a person.

Memory hook: Anger points with people.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is angry / (B) with the delay / (C) at the office. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: about the delay

Rule: Angry about a thing or situation.

Memory hook: Use about for issues.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is afraid / (B) from dogs / (C) since childhood. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: of dogs

Rule: Afraid takes of.

Memory hook: Fear belongs to of.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I am interested / (B) to learn English / (C) properly. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: in learning English

Rule: Interested takes in plus gerund.

Memory hook: Interested in doing.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She is fond / (B) to music / (C) and poetry. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: of music

Rule: Fond takes of.

Memory hook: Fond of is fixed.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is addicted / (B) with gaming / (C) these days. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: to gaming

Rule: Addicted takes to.

Memory hook: Addiction attaches to.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) This is different / (B) than mine / (C) in colour. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: from mine

Rule: Different from is exam-safe standard usage.

Memory hook: SSC prefers different from.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is capable / (B) to solve it / (C) without help. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: of solving it

Rule: Capable takes of plus gerund.

Memory hook: Capable of doing.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is responsible / (B) of the mistake / (C) in the report. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: Part B

Correction: for the mistake

Rule: Responsible for a task or mistake.

Memory hook: Responsibility takes for.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I used to play cricket / (B) when I was a child / (C) in my village. / (D) No error

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The teacher said that / (B) water boils at 100°C / (C) at standard pressure. / (D) No error

Answer: D. No error

Memory hook: Science does not backshift.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He suggested that / (B) I apply for the post / (C) before Monday. / (D) No error

Rule: Suggest that plus base verb is correct formal structure.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She congratulated me / (B) on my success / (C) in the competition. / (D) No error

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The matter was discussed / (B) in detail / (C) during the meeting. / (D) No error

Answer: D. No error

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The rules must be followed / (B) by all candidates / (C) during the exam. / (D) No error

Memory hook: Must be followed is correct.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The road is being repaired / (B) near the station / (C) this week. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: D. No error

Memory hook: Road is being repaired is correct.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He has been working here / (B) since 2020 / (C) without a break. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: D. No error

Rule: Present perfect continuous with since is correct.

Memory hook: Since connects past start to now.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) She has known him / (B) for ten years / (C) through her brother. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: D. No error

Rule: Know is stative and uses present perfect for duration.

Memory hook: Has known is correct.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) I look forward to meeting you / (B) at the seminar / (C) next week. / (D) No error

Answer: D. No error

Memory hook: To is a preposition here.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) He is capable of solving / (B) this problem / (C) without help. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: D. No error

Rule: Capable of takes gerund.

Memory hook: Capable of solving is correct.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) The police are investigating / (B) the case carefully / (C) at present. / (D) No error
cards.definition:
Answer: D. No error

Rule: Police is treated as plural.

Memory hook: Police are is correct.

cards.term: Spot the error: (A) A pair of shoes / (B) is lying / (C) under the bed. / (D) No error

Answer: D. No error
